units.title: Print registration
units.text: Registration is the alignment of separate colour impressions so that each ink layer lands in the intended position on the sheet or web.

units.title: Guard reopening
units.text: After a jam is cleared, the press guard may be reopened only after the drive is stopped, stored energy is released and the operator verifies that tools have been removed.

units.title: Ink approval
units.text: The press foreman approves the production ink mix after comparing the drawdown with the signed colour standard.

units.title: Static control
units.text: Static charge is controlled because excessive charge can attract paper dust and interfere with sheet separation.

units.title: Blanket inspection
units.text: The operator stops the press, illuminates the blanket surface and checks for glazing, cuts and embedded debris before cleaning.
